Paragraph: "As night approaches, my grief doubles, Lakshmana, for the darkness of the world now mirrors the darkness in my mind..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: The arrival of nightfall escalates Rama's psychological distress and sense of isolation.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama openly expresses his vulnerability regarding how nightfall intensifies emotional suffering.
Outcome/Resolution: He shares his internal experience with Lakshmana, seeking emotional release.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Ratri-Anubhav (The psychological impact of nocturnal transition on an agitated mind)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Nightfall symbolizes the temporary obscurity of divine joy, challenging the soul to maintain inner light through faith.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Diurnal fluctuation of mood: emotional vulnerability and depressive thoughts often intensify during twilight and nighttime.
